note: Every clip is side-by-side: top-down pane LEFT, first-person pane RIGHT. Tick ranges refer to the source episode's own tick numbering. EVERY clip plays at 3x real time and carries NO audio stream and no subtitle bar; group action_error carries no overlay at all, and group plan_intention carries only the dialog bubble above the cook's head.

groups.title: 1 - Cheeseburger completion (ground truth)
groups.description: A clean, successful run of the common cheeseburger recipe on the medium map, filmed end to end. The cook executes the stored ground-truth plan with no injected error, no assistant and no dialogue. Top-down left, first-person right, both rendered from a single state per tick so the two panes cannot drift. This clip carries a recipe band across the top instead of the pane labels: the Cheeseburger's three components in the order the recipe demands - bun (raw), patty (fried), cheese (raw) - taken straight from the Recipe definition in cooksim/core/recipes.py, which is ordered, so the plate is only accepted when they are added in that sequence.

groups.title: 2 - Action errors (one per error type, PURE ACTION)
groups.description: One clip for each of the nine error types in the behaviour taxonomy. These are PURE ACTION: there is no assistant, no supervisor, no speech, no subtitle and no recovery attempt - just a short run-up, the cook doing the wrong thing, and a short tail. Each is generated scripted and deterministically by injecting the named behaviour from cooksim/core/error_lib.py into the cheeseburger plan on the medium map, so the error fires at a known tick and the clip is cut exactly around it. None of these clips carries an audio stream.

groups.title: 3 - Plan intention (the cook's own words)
groups.description: The cook announces a LEGITIMATE change of plan, or asks a question - this is not a mistake, even though a supervisor often flags it as one. The only overlay is the dialog bubble anchored above the cook's head; there is no subtitle bar and no voice track. The bubble is held past the utterance so it can still be read at 3x.

clips.title: Cheeseburger completion - ground truth
clips.subtitle: the full successful trajectory, no error and no assistant
clips.caption: The cook executes the stored ground-truth plan for the Cheeseburger on the medium map and delivers the dish. Full trajectory, no injected error and no dialogue, played at 3x. The band across the top states the task: bun (raw) -> patty (fried) -> cheese (raw), added in that exact order.

clips.title: repeat_step
clips.subtitle: re-does a step it already completed
clips.caption: The cook has already put the bun on the plate. After scooping the cheese it walks back to the bun source and scoops a SECOND bun onto the same plate. Doubling an ingredient makes the serve wrong.
clips.generated: scripted (tools/slides_scripted.py); no LLM in the loop

clips.title: forget_next_step
clips.subtitle: stalls doing NOTHING, as if it lost its plan
clips.caption: The cook finishes scooping the meat and then simply stops. It stands in place holding the half-built plate, doing nothing at all, until the order times out.
clips.generated: scripted (tools/slides_scripted.py); no LLM in the loop

clips.title: omit_subgoal
clips.subtitle: a required step silently never happens
clips.caption: Bun and meat are on the plate. The cheese step never happens: the cook walks straight past the cheese station to the serving pass and hands over an incomplete burger, which is rejected.
clips.generated: scripted (tools/slides_scripted.py); no LLM in the loop

clips.title: wrong_order
clips.subtitle: plates the right items in the WRONG order
clips.caption: The Cheeseburger is order-strict: bun first, then meat. The cook carries the empty plate to the pan and scoops the MEAT onto it first, then goes back for the bun. The items are all correct; the order is not.
clips.generated: scripted (tools/slides_scripted.py); no LLM in the loop

clips.title: mis_prep
clips.subtitle: preps the WRONG ingredient at the station
clips.caption: The first step is to get the meat cooking. Instead the cook goes to the lettuce, carries it to the cutting board and chops it. The meat is never started, and the pan stays empty for the whole episode.
clips.generated: scripted (tools/slides_scripted.py); no LLM in the loop

clips.title: add_foreign
clips.subtitle: scoops an ingredient onto the plate that does NOT belong
clips.caption: Bun and meat are plated correctly. On the way to the cheese the cook detours to the lettuce and scoops lettuce onto the plate as well. Lettuce is not in the Cheeseburger, so the serve is rejected.
clips.generated: scripted (tools/slides_scripted.py); no LLM in the loop

clips.title: search
clips.subtitle: visibly hunts for something it needs, wasting time
clips.caption: The cheese is in plain sight, but the cook goes hunting: it walks to two wrong counters in turn and pauses at each before finally finding the cheese station. Nothing is broken - only time is lost.
clips.generated: scripted (tools/slides_scripted.py); no LLM in the loop

clips.title: serve_raw
clips.subtitle: plates an ingredient RAW when the recipe requires it cooked
clips.caption: The pan is never lit. After the bun, the cook scoops the meat straight from its crate onto the plate - raw - and carries it to the serving pass. A food-safety violation, and the order is rejected.
clips.generated: scripted (tools/slides_scripted.py); no LLM in the loop

clips.title: leave_unattended
clips.subtitle: leaves done food on a hot station until it smokes
clips.caption: The meat finishes cooking, but instead of collecting it the cook wanders the kitchen on other business. The pan starts to smoke behind it and keeps smoking while the cook walks away - the run ends in a fire.
clips.generated: scripted (tools/slides_scripted.py); no LLM in the loop

clips.title: Announced plan change
clips.subtitle: the cook says it will fetch the plate first, then does it
clips.caption: The cook announces a legal reordering - plate first, meat after - and then carries it out, picking the plate up and setting it on the counter. Not a mistake, though a supervisor often flags it as one.

clips.title: Announced plan change (frames observation)
clips.subtitle: same announced reordering, different observation stack
clips.caption: The same announced reordering under the frames-only observation: the cook states the plan up front and then fetches the plate before starting the meat.

clips.title: Announced side quest
clips.subtitle: the cook takes a detour it knows is off-recipe
clips.caption: The cook announces it is going to chop lettuce while the meat finishes - a detour nobody asked for, which it knows does not harm the dish - and heads for the lettuce.

clips.title: Announced side quest (frames observation)
clips.subtitle: the same detour, announced before it starts
clips.caption: The cook says it is going to chop lettuce first and walks off to do it, leaving the recipe's next step for afterwards.

clips.title: Announced side quest (novice cook)
clips.subtitle: an apologetic cook announces the same detour
clips.caption: A novice cook announces the same lettuce detour - politely, and while promising to come straight back - and goes to the lettuce station.

clips.title: The cook asks a question
clips.subtitle: not an error - a request for information
clips.caption: The cook stops and asks what is in the pan and whether it is done. It is not confused about the recipe and has made no mistake; it wants a fact it cannot read off its own view.

clips.title: The cook asks a question (frames observation)
clips.subtitle: the same question under the frames-only stack
clips.caption: The cook pauses mid-task to ask exactly what is in the pan and whether it is actually done yet, then carries on.

clips.title: The cook asks before acting
clips.subtitle: a check before flipping the burner on
clips.caption: Before turning the burner on, the novice cook checks what is in the pan and whether it is already done. Asking is legitimate behaviour, not a deviation.

clips.title: The cook asks before acting (frames observation)
clips.subtitle: the same check, frames-only observation
clips.caption: The cook interrupts its own routine to ask what is in the pan and whether it is fully cooked, before going for the plate.

virtualhome.note: VirtualHome clips. Same conventions as the CookSim clips: top-down pane LEFT, first-person RIGHT, no audio stream, no overlay on the action_error group. Error clips play at 3x; the ground-truth clip plays at 1x (see its speed_exception). Frame ranges refer to each render's own frame numbering -- VirtualHome re-renders are not frame-identical, so ranges are not comparable across renders of the same case.

groups.title: Room tidy completion (ground truth)
groups.description: A clean run of the long-horizon tidy task -- 'Tidy up across all the rooms: turn off every device that is on and close anything left open' (episode tidy_hard). No injected error, no assistant, no dialogue.

groups.title: Action errors (one per error type, PURE ACTION)
groups.description: One clip per class in the six-class VirtualHome taxonomy, cut to the ERROR MOMENT only: a short run-up, the agent doing the wrong thing, a short tail. No assistant, no speech, no subtitle, no recovery. Each error is injected by behavior_lib_vh into the routine_hard plan and verified symbolically before rendering, so it fires at a known item and the clip is cut exactly around it. These run on routine_hard, not the tidy task: tidy_hard has no fetch/deposit subgoal, so wrong_object and wrong_placement are not expressible there.

clips.speed_exception: plays at 1x, not the manifest default 3x: the task is only 8.2s of footage and 3x would leave 2.8s
